roles.title: Staff Product Manager, Growth & E-commerce Experimentation
roles.description:
About Us

At Prenuvo, we are on a mission to flip the paradigm from reactive “sick-care” to proactive health care. Our award-winning whole body scan is fast (under 1 hour), safe (MRI has no ionizing radiation), and non-invasive (no contrast). Our unique integrated stack of optimized hardware, software, and increasingly AI, coupled with the patient-centric experience across our domestic and global clinics, have allowed us to lead the change against “we caught it too late again".

We are looking for a Staff Product Manager, Growth & E-commerce Experimentation to accelerate how Prenuvo learns and improves across our digital commerce experience.

This is a hands-on growth product role. You will own a high-velocity experimentation roadmap across the customer consideration and purchase journey, from landing pages and product discovery through selection, booking, checkout, and immediate post-purchase experiences. You will turn customer behavior, qualitative insight, and business data into clear hypotheses and measurable tests.

You will partner closely with Design, Engineering, Analytics, Marketing, E-commerce, Clinical, Legal, Privacy, and Operations to move quickly without compromising patient trust or the integrity of the healthcare experience.

An immediate area of focus will be improving conversion and learning velocity across Prenuvo’s booking experience: understanding where customers experience friction, testing how we position and package our offerings, and building the instrumentation required to know what is working and why.

You will help Prenuvo evolve from running individual tests to operating a durable experimentation engine that continuously improves the customer experience and informs broader product strategy.

This role does not provide visa sponsorship. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire and must not require employer sponsorship for a work visa (current or future).

Help reshape the world through proactive healthcare while working with cutting-edge technology and high performing teams with deep expertise - join us to make a difference in people’s lives!

What You'll Do

Own a prioritized e-commerce experimentation roadmap tied to clear customer and business outcomes, including conversion, product selection, booking completion, average order value, and repeat purchase.

Use funnel analysis, behavioral data, customer research, and qualitative feedback to identify the highest-value friction points and growth opportunities across the digital journey.

Turn opportunities into clear hypotheses with defined target populations, success metrics, guardrails, and decision criteria before tests launch.

Partner with Design and Engineering to prototype, build, and launch A/B tests and other experiments rapidly while maintaining a high-quality patient experience.

Build the measurement and instrumentation needed to understand customer behavior across landing, selection, scheduling, checkout, and post-purchase flows.

Analyze experiment results with Analytics, distinguish signal from noise, and translate findings into clear product decisions, follow-up tests, or scaled experiences.

Partner with Marketing and E-commerce on offer, merchandising, messaging, pricing, packaging, and channel-to-site experiments while maintaining clear product ownership of the end-to-end experience.

Establish lightweight experimentation standards, documentation, and learning loops so insights are reusable rather than lost after an individual test ends.

Ensure experiments account for healthcare-specific guardrails, including clinical accuracy, privacy, legal requirements, accessibility, operational readiness, and customer trust.

What You’ll Bring

8+ years of product management experience, with meaningful experience in consumer growth, e-commerce, conversion optimization, or experimentation.

A track record of improving digital funnels through structured experimentation and measurable product changes.

Hands-on experience designing and evaluating A/B tests, including hypotheses, success metrics, guardrails, segmentation, and experiment interpretation.

Strong analytical fluency and comfort working with funnel data, behavioral analytics, experiment results, and dashboards to make product decisions.

Excellent product judgment with the ability to balance conversion opportunities with customer comprehension, trust, and long-term value.

Experience partnering closely with product design and engineering to move from insight to shipped experiment quickly.

Experience working across Marketing, E-commerce, Analytics, and other commercial teams where ownership can span multiple functions.

Ability to separate a customer problem from a proposed solution and design tests that generate useful learning, not just activity.

Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain experiment design, results, uncertainty, and recommendations to executives and cross-functional teams.

Comfort operating in ambiguity, prioritizing among many possible tests, and making practical trade-offs between rigor and speed.

Experience in healthcare, health technology, regulated consumer products, or another high-trust environment is preferred.

Experience in a high-growth or scale-up environment is strongly preferred.

How You Work

You are naturally curious about customer behavior. When you see a drop-off, unexpected pattern, or strong opinion, your instinct is to ask what we can learn and how we can test it.

You are analytical without becoming academic. You care about experimental rigor, but you also know how to make pragmatic decisions when perfect data is not available.

You move quickly and collaborate well across functions. You can challenge assumptions, narrow an oversized idea into a testable hypothesis, and keep teams focused on the learning that matters.

Most importantly, you understand that growth in healthcare depends on trust. You optimize the commercial experience without compromising clarity, clinical integrity, or the patient experience.

Our Values

First: we are Pioneers

Transforming healthcare requires divergent thinking, bias for action, disciplined experimentation, and consistent grit and determination to maintain momentum. This journey is as challenging as it is rewarding.

Second: we are Platform-Builders

We’re always building foundations that allow us to achieve tomorrow more than we did today. We never lose sight of what’s ahead – in a mindset of ownership and duty to our mission.

Above all: we are Patients

We could all be the next person who walks through our very doors, seeking clarity or peace of mind. We are proud of our impact on our patients’ lives, and we won’t stop till everyone can benefit from our work.

What We Offer

An avenue to make a positive impact on people's lives and their health

We believe in preventative healthcare for everyone, including our team - Prenuvo provides free, whole-body scans to each team member

Growth opportunities are at the heart of our people journey, we’re doing big things with bright minds - there is no single path to success, it can be shaped along the way

Building strong relationships is at the core of everything we do - our team gets together each week to connect, share, and socialize

Recognizing time away to restore is vital to our wellbeing - we have a flexible vacation policy and we will encourage you to use it

Prenuvo offers a 401(k) retirement savings plan to eligible employees, allowing team members to make pre-tax contributions toward their retirement. While Prenuvo facilitates access to the plan, the company does not currently offer matching contributions.

We offer a comprehensive benefits package including health, dental, vision, including Mental Health coverage, to support you and your family

The base salary for this role ranges from $161,500-$190,000 in local currency, depending upon experience and geographic location

We are an equal-opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

As part of the hiring process, successful candidates will undergo a background check in compliance to applicable federal, provincial, and state rules.

Please be advised that official communication from our recruitment team will only come from our authorized domain [prenuvo.com]. If you are contacted by a recruiter, please ensure their email address ends with @prenuvo.com. We do not use third-party recruitment services or any other email domains for hiring purposes. If you receive communication that you believe to be fraudulent, please report it immediately to jobs@prenuvo.com.

roles.title: Senior Product Manager, Retailer App Platform & Insights
roles.location: Canada - Remote (ON, AB, BC, or NS Only)
roles.description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview

About the Role: We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to shape how some of the world's largest retailers manage and grow their digital businesses on Instacart.

You'll own Retailer App as a platform, building a consumer-grade experience where retailers can easily manage their storefronts, discover and adopt new capabilities, and take greater control of their businesses. You'll also build the foundations that enable product teams across Instacart to deliver great retailer experiences quickly, consistently, and safely.

In parallel, you'll own Analytics & Insights, one of Retailer App's core products, transforming retailer data into actionable insights that help retailers grow.

Across both areas, you'll set a compelling multi-half product vision and strategy, translating customer needs into differentiated products and measurable outcomes. You'll be expected to operate with exceptional ownership and velocity, driving complex initiatives from ambiguity to launch, aligning teams across Product, Design, Engineering, and Data, and working directly with leading enterprise retailers to uncover needs and deliver scalable solutions.

This role offers a unique combination of platform-wide influence, end-to-end product ownership, and direct business impact — with the opportunity to define the next generation of retailer tools.

About the Team - Instacart’s Enterprise Platform team is responsible for the white-label product that enables retailers of all sizes to compete online through their own ecommerce experiences. The team is focused on platform growth and long-term retailer success — from onboarding new partners to helping them acquire, serve, and retain their end customers in ways that align with their unique brand and strategy.

About the Job

Retailer App Platform — Build a consumer-grade retailer experience

Build a consumer-grade experience: Make Retailer App intuitive, cohesive, and delightful, with seamless navigation, personalized homepages, and end-to-end workflows that make it effortless for retailers to get their jobs done.

Drive feature discovery and adoption: Surface and merchandise the growing suite of Storefront Pro capabilities so retailers can easily discover valuable features, understand their benefits, and adopt or upgrade to unlock more value.

Empower retailers through self-service: Build intuitive self-service experiences that allow retailers to explore, configure, and manage their storefront capabilities with greater flexibility, transparency, and control.

Enable teams to build fast and safely: Establish reusable components, templates, common UX patterns, and governance frameworks that help product teams ship high-quality, consistent retailer experiences with speed and confidence.

Own the end-to-end experience: Set the vision and standards for Retailer App across product teams, ensuring individual features come together into one coherent, exceptional experience rather than a collection of disconnected tools.

Analytics & Insights — Turn retailer data into growth

Make performance understandable: Build intuitive analytics experiences that give retailers visibility into their commerce, content, and product performance, helping them understand what's happening and why.

Turn data into actionable insights: Move beyond traditional dashboards to deliver personalized, data-backed recommendations that surface the most valuable opportunities to grow.

Connect insights to action: Enable retailers to act directly on recommendations through streamlined workflows, automation, and AI-powered capabilities.

Shape the future of retailer intelligence: Build toward a proactive, intelligent experience that continuously helps retailers identify opportunities, optimize their businesses, and measure impact.

Product Leadership, Execution & Collaboration

Set product direction: Define a compelling multi-half vision and strategy, translating customer needs and emerging technologies into a pragmatic roadmap with measurable outcomes.

Execute with speed and ownership: Independently drive complex initiatives from ambiguity to launch, making smart tradeoffs and delivering high-quality products with exceptional throughput.

Lead across teams: Influence and align a broad set of cross-functional stakeholders, navigating competing priorities and driving decisions without direct authority.

Build in deep partnership: Work closely with Design, Engineering, Data, and other product teams to deliver cohesive experiences across a complex platform.

Stay close to customers: Engage directly with leading enterprise retailers to uncover needs, validate solutions, and turn complex requirements into scalable products.

About You

Minimum Qualifications

8+ years of B2B product management experience, including 2+ years building platform products.

Exceptional product craft and UX judgment: Strong intuition for creating intuitive, elegant experiences that simplify complex customer workflows.

Strong platform product thinking: Experience building scalable platforms, shared capabilities, and frameworks that enable multiple teams to deliver products efficiently and consistently.

Exceptional ownership and execution: Proven ability to independently set direction, navigate ambiguity, make high-quality decisions, and ship complex products at high velocity.

Cross-functional leadership: Ability to influence teams without direct authority, align stakeholders with competing priorities, and drive decisions across a broad product surface.

Customer-centric product strategy: Ability to deeply understand customer problems and translate them into differentiated, scalable solutions.

Strong analytical and communication skills: Fluent in quantitative and qualitative decision-making, with the ability to articulate compelling strategies and build trust with senior leaders and enterprise customers.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience building B2B SaaS platforms, enterprise applications, or products used to manage complex business workflows.

Experience with e-commerce, retail technology, content management systems, or site-building platforms.

Experience building analytics, business intelligence, or data-driven recommendation products.

Experience using AI to create more intelligent, proactive, or automated product experiences.

Experience with configuration platforms, developer enablement, or B2B self-service tools.

#LI-Remote

Instacart provides highly market-competitive compensation and benefits in each location where our employees work. This role is remote and the base pay range for a successful candidate is dependent on their permanent work location. Please review our Flex First remote work policy here. Currently, we are only hiring in the following provinces: Ontario, Alberta, British Columbia, and Nova Scotia.

Offers may vary based on many factors, such as candidate experience and skills required for the role. Additionally, this role is eligible for a new hire equity grant as well as annual refresh grants. Please read more about our benefits offerings here.

For Canadian based candidates, the base pay ranges for a successful candidate are listed below.

roles.title: Principal Product Manager, Accounts & Automation (Remote)
roles.description:
Overview of the Role
We’re on a mission to modernize insurance - making it simpler, more accessible, and customer-first. The insurance industry is a $1T market that’s remained largely untouched by the digital revolution, and PolicyMe is here to change that. As a remote-first, Toronto-based startup with big ambitions, we’re looking for a product leader to help us build the future of insurance in Canada - and beyond.
We are now seeking a Principal Product Manager to join our Accounts & Automation team within our product organization. This role will own several areas of scope, including:
Defining the strategy and roadmap to make us the go-to provider for all of our customers’ personal insurance needs, including the platform-wide programs and features that drive multi-product adoption
Building trust digitally across the products we offer, so customers feel similar levels of confidence and reassurance as they would get when they speak with one our licensed advisors

This is a highly strategic and hands-on leadership role that blends product vision, analytical thinking, structured execution, and cross-functional leadership. You will be responsible for shaping long-term product direction while also driving day-to-day execution across multiple complex initiatives. Reporting to the VP of Product, you will work closely with leaders across Engineering, Design, Growth, Operations, Customer Success, and Data to build products that create exceptional customer outcomes and drive meaningful business impact.

roles.title: Product Manager, Agent Harness & Modelling
roles.description:
Who are we?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

ABOUT COHERE AND NORTH

Cohere is revolutionizing enterprise AI with North, an agentic AI platform designed to securely deploy AI agents and automations within organizations' infrastructure. North empowers employees to streamline workflows, automate repetitive tasks, and unlock actionable insights while ensuring data privacy and compliance. North combines cutting-edge generative and search models with customizable integrations to drive productivity and innovation at scale.

ROLE OVERVIEW

We are seeking an Agent Harness Product Manager to own the execution layer that makes North agents reliable, capable, and production-ready. This is a role that sits at the intersection of three domains:

Agent Loop and Execution.

Own the core agent runtime: tool orchestration, parallel execution, sub-agent delegation, sandbox code execution, and failure recovery. You will define how North agents plan and act across long, multi-step workflows and ensure the execution environment is robust enough for the most demanding enterprise tasks. You are expected to engage at the implementation level, contributing to architecture decisions alongside engineering rather than simply handing off requirements.

Context Engineering.

Own how our Agents manage the context window as a deliberately controlled resource. This includes progressive disclosure of tools and skills, context compaction and summarization, offloading of large payloads to a persistent filesystem, and the instrumentation that keeps agents oriented across extended trajectories.

Model-Scaffolding Co-evolution.

Own the feedback loop between North's harness and the Modeling Team. This PM is the connective tissue that makes that possible: ensuring harness design decisions are validated by Modeling before they are built, that evals are the shared bridge between both teams, and that as the harness evolves the model evolves with it.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Define and own the roadmap for North's agent harness, including the agent loop, context engineering layer, tool orchestration, sandbox execution, and sub-agent delegation

- Serve as the primary interface between North engineering and Cohere's Modeling team, ensuring new harness capabilities are validated before being built and that neither team paints itself into a corner

- Own North's agentic evaluation framework, ensuring evals are compatible with both the North harness and Modeling's training infrastructure, and that they serve as a reliable bridge between product and research

- Engage enterprise customers to surface real-world agentic failures and translate findings into concrete product and model requirements

- Partner with the agentic expert modeling team to define goals that maximize the impact of our models and prioritize model capabilities and evals most critical for delivering on those goals. Establish a clear roadmap for our agentic modeling capabilities.

- Stay current with the open-source and commercial agent ecosystem and drive adoption decisions that keep North's architecture aligned with emerging standards.

REQUIREMENTS

- 5+ years of product management experience as a research PM, in agentic AI systems,, or applied ML products

- Deep understanding of agentic harnesses, including the latest paid and open source offerings.

- Deep understanding of modern LLM agent architectures, including multi-agent systems, tool-augmented reasoning, memory and retrieval, programmatic orchestration, RAG, and long-horizon execution

- Strong grasp of agentic evaluation design, including how to measure task completion, failure recovery, and long-horizon reliability, and how to diagnose model vs. scaffolding gaps

- Technically deep enough to contribute to architecture decisions at the implementation level: comfortable reviewing and shaping design docs, reasoning about async execution patterns, sandboxed environments, filesystem design, and the tradeoffs that come with building harness capabilities into a production platform

- Ability to flex between ML research conversations and engineering architecture discussions with equal fluency

- Track record of shipping platform-layer products with demonstrated impact on reliability, performance, or capability.

NICE-TO-HAVES

- Direct experience in developing and shipping leading agentic harnesses.

- An active practitioner of agent frameworks who regularly builds with and follows the latest developments in open-source harnesses, coding agents, and orchestration tools in both professional and personal work

- Hands-on experience with enterprise agentic deployments: multi-tenant orchestration, tool permissioning, audit trails, and compliance requirements

- Familiarity with infrastructure constraints relevant to enterprise deployments: on-premises environments, scalability challenges, and the operational tradeoffs of running complex agent workloads in restricted or air-gapped settings

- Prior work at the intersection of research and product, translating nascent model capabilities into shipped product features

- Background working within or closely alongside an ML research or post-training team.

WHY JOIN COHERE?

- Impact: Shape how Canada's most important public institutions adopt and deploy frontier AI.

- Innovation: Work alongside leading researchers and engineers solving complex ML challenges.

- Growth: Competitive compensation, equity options, and opportunities for professional development.

- Flexibility: Hybrid work model with offices in key global locations (Toronto, Montreal, New York, San Francisco, London, Paris, and Korea)

FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS:

- A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

- Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

- RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

- 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

- Annual enrichment benefits:

Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.

Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

- 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

- Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.

HOW AND WHERE WE WORK:

- Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.

- For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

- For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

- Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.

If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply.

We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs.

We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider.

Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers https://cohere.com/careers page.

HOW AND WHERE WE WORK:

- Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.

- For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

- For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

- Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.

If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply.

We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs.

We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider.

Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers https://cohere.com/careers page.
